pr_title: ESQL: Support loading shapes from source into WKB blocks
pr_body:
Similarly to https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/103698, this PR adds support for reading geo_shape and shape fields into wkb blocks so they can use top project the data to the result of a ES|QL query.

One of the points for discussion in this PR is the naming use to the ES|QL fields where geo_shape has been renamed to geography and shape has been renamed to geometry, to follow more closely industry standards. Although this is debatable.

Note to the reviewer: There is a limitation on csv test because they cannot deal with WKT,

Fixes #103586

issue_context.title: Support geo_shape in ES|QL
issue_context.body:
### Description

In https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/103585 we added support for `geo_point` in ES|QL. The next most obvious type to support is `geo_shape`: In addition we should support functions for this:

* `to_geoshape(string)` to take a WKT string and convert it to a `geo_shape`
* `to_string(geo_shape)` should take a `geo_shape` and convert it to WKT
comments: This is mostly blocked by https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/103751. We need to know how the field is going to be consumed because we want to load different data structures depending on that.

review_comments: I think we can now delete AbstractPointFieldType, as I only created that class to implement the blockLoader for points only, and disable it for shapes. Now that it exists for shapes too, we can have all code there, I assume.
OK, I see now your comment that we do not support null-values for shapes. So that is one reason to keep this class.
I presume we could use `ip_range` here too, as in the other tests?
Slightly awkward that the unsupported field is called `unsupported`, but on the other hand perhaps this field will never be supported, and this is perfect. 🤷
